# encapi_status (Resource)

A Puppet environment, referred to as a status (e.g. testing, production, development). Nodes may only reference a status that exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Statuses map to Puppet environments. Define as many as you need;
# a node can only be pinned to one that exists.
resource "encapi_status" "testing" {
  name = "testing"
}

resource "encapi_status" "production" {
  name        = "production"
  description = "Production environment"
}

resource "encapi_status" "development" {
  name = "development"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Status/environment name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by status name.
terraform import encapi_status.production production
```
